content.name: Sravani Reddy
content.title: Senior OPD Assistant (Clinical Support)
content.summary: Clinical support professional with nine years in hospital OPDs, starting as a certified General Duty Assistant and now running patient flow for a 40-doctor eye hospital outpatient wing. Reduced average OPD waiting time from 85 to 50 minutes through token re-design and pre-consultation testing.

experience.title: General Duty Assistant
bullets: Assisted nurses on a 30-bed medical ward with patient positioning, vitals, bed-making and transfers for 10–12 patients per shift.
Collected and labelled urine and stool samples and transported specimens to the lab within the 30-minute turnaround target.
Supported discharge counselling for Telugu-speaking families on diet and wound hygiene.

experience.title: OPD Assistant
bullets: Prepared 80–100 patients a day for consultations, recording height, weight, BP and SpO2 in the hospital information system.
Ran the ECG room and assisted in minor procedures such as suture removal and dressings.
Managed preventive health check packages, raising same-day report completion from 70% to 92%.
Trained 5 new OPD assistants on vitals, billing counters and patient etiquette.

experience.title: Senior OPD Assistant
bullets: Coordinate patient flow for a 40-doctor outpatient wing seeing around 650 patients a day, leading a team of 12 assistants.
Redesigned the token system and moved vision and pressure tests to before consultation, cutting average waiting time from 85 to 50 minutes.
Track daily OPD revenue and cash counters, reconciling about ₹6 lakh in collections each day with zero audit shortfalls in 2025.
Organised 18 free rural eye screening camps that referred 1,100 patients for cataract surgery.

achievements.title: Best Team Leader, OPD
